summary: RGC Resources, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its utility subsidiary Roanoke Gas Company entered a $15 million unsecured delayed-draw promissory note via a Fourth Amendment to its Loan Agreement with Pinnacle Bank. The funds, drawn by August 20, 2026, repay a maturing note, with interest at Term SOFR plus 100 bps, swapped to a fixed 5.13%. Maturity is August 20, 2029. There are no special-situation elements; this is routine corporate financing and debt management.
